citations.long: Drug products are not stored under appropriate conditions of temperature so that their identity, strength, quality, and purity are not affected.
Clothing of personnel engaged in the packing and holding of drug products is not appropriate for the duties they perform.

citations.short: Late submission of annual safety reports
citations.long: Not all annual periodic adverse drug experience reports have been submitted within 60 days of the anniversary date of the approval of the application.

citations.short: Late submission of quarterly safety reports
citations.long: Not all quarterly periodic adverse drug experience reports have been submitted within 30 days of the close of the quarter.
An annual report was not submitted within 60 days of the anniversary date of U.S. approval of the application to the FDA division responsible for reviewing the application.
Procedures describing the handling of written and oral complaints related to drug products are deficiently written or followed.

citations.short: Procedures not  in writing, fully followed
citations.long: The responsibilities and procedures applicable to the quality control unit are not in writing.

citations.short: Contamination, chemical or physical change, deterioration
citations.long: An NDA-Field Alert Report was not submitted within three working days of receipt of information concerning significant chemical, physical, or other change or deterioration in a distributed drug product.
